declared.title: Emotion-regulation strategies across psychopathology: A meta-analytic review
declared.foundIn: docs/design/review-science.md (dossier du pilote, 2026-11-22) ; titre de mémoire de la session

population: 114 studies, 241 effect sizes, dispositional emotion regulation

findings.text: Across 114 studies, acceptance goes with fewer symptoms, but less strongly than rumination or avoidance go with more

support.sentence: We found a large effect size for rumination, medium to large for avoidance, problem solving, and suppression, and small to medium for reappraisal and acceptance.
